newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle sell $112/dressed, up $1-trade.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle sell $112/dressed, up $1-trade.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle sold at $111.00 to $112.00 per cwt on a dressed basis in light activity near midday Wednesday, steady to $1.00 higher than Tuesday's active sales, market sources said.
About 1,000 head of slaughter steers and heifers that will likely grade select and choice sold in western Nebraska. The sales brought Nebraska's weekly total to near 40,000 head, sources said.
Further bids at $111.000 were passed by owners pricing cattle at $112.00 to $113.00. Bids at $68.00 on a live basis were passed, with asking levels mostly at $69.00, they said.
